# 💡 Feature Ideas & Community Wishlist

Have an idea for a feature, usability improvement, or workflow enhancement? Share it here with the community before writing a formal issue or architecture decision record (ADR).

### 🎯 What makes a great proposal:
- **Use Case**: What problem are you facing or what workflow could be smoother?
- **GUI & CLI Parity**: LewdZone Launcher follows the "One core, two entry points" philosophy (Rule 03 & Rule 13). Any feature added to the desktop app should ideally have an equivalent CLI command.
- **Feasibility & Dependencies**: Does the feature rely on external APIs, native OS capabilities, or site scrapers?

Share your thoughts or upvote ideas you'd love to see implemented!
